name: client-360
description: Customer 360 Reinvented — an Accenture accelerator: a worklist-first commercial-credit relationship cockpit for C&I bankers, as a full React application. Reads the book live from Salesforce (nCino + FSC) via the org-hosted Customer360 MCP server (8 read tools, per-user OAuth) plus Boom-spread financials, renders an interactive Cowork artifact: needs-action worklist with reason codes, per-account Activity audit trail (client requests, concluded analyses, next steps), exposure & collateral, covenants with effective-challenge validation, relationship graph, whitespace, structural early-warning signals, a page-agnostic AI chat, and a data-gated Client Actions control center. Use when a banker asks to open the Customer 360, pull up the relationship view, work the needs-action queue, or act on a client request.
